optimized_sql: SELECT i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name, MAX(ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit, MAX(sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss, MAX(cs.cs_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit FROM store_sales AS ss JOIN store AS s ON s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk JOIN item AS i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk JOIN date_dim AS d1 ON d1.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk AND d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999 JOIN store_returns AS sr ON sr.sr_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk AND sr.sr_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk AND sr.sr_ticket_number = ss.ss_ticket_number JOIN date_dim AS d2 ON d2.d_date_sk = sr.sr_returned_date_sk AND d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999 JOIN (SELECT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk AS cs_bill_customer_sk, catalog_sales.cs_item_sk AS cs_item_sk, MAX(catalog_sales.cs_net_profit) AS cs_profit FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_dim AS d3 ON d3.d_date_sk = catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk WHERE d3.d_year = 1999 AND d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, catalog_sales.cs_item_sk) AS cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr.sr_customer_sk AND cs.cs_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk GROUP BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name ORDER BY i.i_item_id, i.i_item_desc, s.s_store_id, s.s_store_name LIMIT 100
